Edge(int t, int c, int w, int r) : to(t), cap(c), w(w), revIdx(r) {} }; vector> adj; vector> matrix; vector dist; int nodes, source, sink, flow; int cost; const int INF = INT_MAX / 100; MinCostFlow(int n, int src, int tgt) { nodes = n; source = src; sink = tgt; flow = 0; cost = 0; adj.resize(nodes); dist.resize(nodes); } void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int w) { int su = adj[u].size(), sv = adj[v].size(); adj[u].push_back(Edge(v, cap, w, sv)); adj[v].push_back(Edge(u, 0, -w, su)); } void buildMatrix() { matrix.resize(nodes); for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) { matrix[i] = adj[i]; adj[i].clear(); } } bool shortestPath(bool detectNeg) { fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF); } } } } if (detectNeg) { for (int u = 0; u < nodes; u++) { if (dist[u] == INF) continue; for (const Edge& e : matrix[u]) { if (e.cap > 0 && dist[u] + e.w < dist[e.to]) return false; } } } return true; } vector pnode, pedge, vis, distQ; vector q; bool spfa() { pnode.resize(nodes); pedge.resize(nodes); vis.resize(nodes, 0); distQ.resize(nodes, INF); q.resize(nodes); fill(distQ.begin(), distQ.end(), INF); if (e.cap == 0) continue; int nd = distQ[u] + e.w; if (nd < distQ[e.to]) { if (vis[e.to] == 0) { q[tail++] = e.to; if (tail == nodes) tail = 0; } else if (vis[e.to] == 2) { if (--head == -1) head += nodes; q[head] = e.to; } vis[e.to] = 1; pedge[e.to] = i; pnode[e.to] = u; distQ[e.to] = nd; } } } return vis[sink] != 0; } struct P { int node, dist; P(int n, int d) : node(n), dist(d) {} bool operator<(const P& o) const { return dist > o.dist; } }; bool dijkstraP() { vis.assign(nodes, 0); distQ.assign(nodes, INF); pnode.resize(nodes); pedge.resize(nodes); priority_queue

pq; pq.push(P(source, 0)); distQ[source] = 0; while (!pq.empty()) { P cur = pq.top(); pq.pop(); while (distQ[cur.node] < cur.dist) { if (pq.empty()) return false; cur = pq.top(); pq.pop(); } vis[cur.node] = 2; for (int i = 0; i < matrix[cur.node].size(); i++) { Edge e = matrix[cur.node][i]; if (e.cap == 0) continue; int rcost = e.w + dist[cur.node] - dist[e.to]; int nd = cur.dist + rcost; if (nd < distQ[e.to]) { if (vis[e.to] == 2) return false; pq.push(P(e.to, nd)); distQ[e.to] = nd; pnode[e.to] = cur.node; pedge[e.to] = i; vis[e.to] = 1; } } } return vis[sink] != 0; } int augmentFlow() { int pathCap = INF; int cur = sink; while (cur != source) { int prev = pnode[cur], idx = pedge[cur]; pathCap = min(pathCap, matrix[prev][idx].cap); cur = prev; } cur = sink; while (cur != source) { int prev = pnode[cur], idx = pedge[cur]; matrix[prev][idx].cap -= pathCap; matrix[cur][matrix[prev][idx].revIdx].cap += pathCap; cur = prev; } flow += pathCap; return pathCap; } void compute() { shortestPath(false); while (spfa()) { if (distQ[sink] >= INF - 1) break; cost += distQ[sink] * augmentFlow(); } } void computeWithPot() { shortestPath(false); while (dijkstraP()) { int m = distQ[sink] + dist[sink] - dist[source]; if (m >= INF - 1) break; cost += m * augmentFlow(); for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) { if (vis[i] != 0) dist[i] += distQ[i] - dist[source]; } } } }; void process(int testNum, istream& in, ostream& out) { int n, m, k, c, d; in >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d; int maxLen = n + k; int dest = n * maxLen + 1; MinCostFlow g(dest + 1, 0, dest); vector freq(n + 1, 0); lvl < maxLen - 1; lvl++) { g.addEdge(lvl * n + i, (lvl + 1) * n + i, k, c); } } for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) { int u, v; in >> u >> v; for (int lvl = 0; lvl < maxLen - 1; lvl++) { for (int p = 1; p <= k; lvl++) { g.addEdge(lvl * n + 1, dest, k, 0); } g.buildMatrix(); g.computeWithPot(); if (g.flow != k) out << "BUG" << endl; else out << g.cost << endl; } }; void start() { istream& in = cin; ostream& out = cout;
